content: The mirror does not flatter the emperor; it reflects only the unvarnished face.
author: Persian Proverbs
sourceWork: Ayineh choon naghsh-e to benmood rast — Nezami Ganjavi
explanation: Courtiers, sycophants, and social media followers will tell you whatever preserves your favor. But polished glass possesses zero ambition and zero fear: it reveals the wrinkles, the gray hair, and the stains without apology. Seek friends who serve as honest mirrors.
practicalInsight: Look at an honest critique of your work today as a precious mirror rather than an assault on your dignity.
reflectionPrompt: Have you surrounded yourself with flatterers who tell you what you want to hear, blinding you to reality?
